notes: US708 is the only individually identifiable star in the supplied paper. It is discussed as a known HVS and compared with the models (T:p4-b7), and later mentioned as a possible former Type Ia SN companion (T:p6-b11); I therefore record it as follow-up rather than a candidate newly found here. Its quoted v_rf ≈ 750 km/s satisfies the paper's quoted 400 km/s Galactic-escape criterion (T:p4-b4; see also T:p1-b7). The simulated stars and the unnamed observed HVS samples are not individually identifiable, so they are not separate roster entries.

US708: US708 appears only as a comparison object; the only numeric value given is v_rf ≃ 750 km/s from Hirsch et al. (2005) (also referenced at T:p6-b11 without numbers). The paper defines v_rf as the Galactic rest-frame radial velocity (T:p1-b7), so it is recorded as a Galactic rest-frame velocity rather than a heliocentric/barycentric radial velocity.
